plan.notes: Source: Alexandria Technical & Community College 2025-2026 Catalog (official PDF, updated August 25, 2025), 'Individualized Studies' Associate of Applied Science degree course sequence, PROGRAM CREDITS: 60. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01. The catalog describes this as a personalized degree: students work with faculty/staff to create a degree plan (20-30 technical credits, 30-40 MN Transfer Curriculum credits). 'Technical Course' slots are student-defined courses chosen individually with advisor approval, so no fixed course list exists; they are recorded as choice slots with no options. The catalog does not list prerequisites in the sequence.
